description: Change one or more validated settings on a specific instance (by id or exact name), then save them. This is the correct way to change server configuration, since it runs the same validation as the panel and writes config files the game actually reads, unlike hand-editing files. Call get_settings first to get exact field ids, current values and allowed options. All changes are saved together, or none are.

changes.description: The settings to change. Each entry needs the exact `field` id from get_settings and the new `value`, typed as the setting expects (boolean for toggles, number for numeric settings, one of the listed option values for choices).

field.description: Exact field id from get_settings, e.g. "minecraft:difficulty".

value.description: The new value for this setting.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be changed, including the old and new value of each setting and getting their approval.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: set_settings
title: Change Instance Settings
